method.cases: Nine fixed cases declared before this run; one trial per case; no cherry-picked retries.

method.baseline: One model call writes the same three editorial roles using the same evidence, role briefs, calculations and source verdict. No tool-selection round trips.
method.scoring: Identical editorial guards and citation checks. Guard acceptance is not semantic truth. No model judge. No audience study.
method.cost: Requests and reported tokens; no inferred dollar cost.
